title: Praetorian Guard
subtitle: Galactic Empire
description: A precursor to the highly skilled Praetorian Guards later used by Supreme Leader Snoke. The Imperial Praetorians were dispatched by the Empire's Shadow council to aid Moff Gideon in his battle over the planet Mandalore. The Praetorian Guards eliminated Paz Vizsla, and later fought The Mandalorian Din Djarin and Grogu, who was suited up in the IG-12 mech suit.
